title: process_turn_async returns immediately without blocking
preconditions: CA engine initialized, Ollama LLM available
steps: Record return time and returned turn_index.
Execute an immediate log statement after the call to verify main thread progress.
Assert that elapsed time from start to return is < 50ms.
Verify that a background thread was spawned by checking that a log entry containing 'C-stage async dispatched for turn' appears within 500ms.
expected: Return time < 50ms. turn_index is an integer. Background thread starts (log present).

title: Incremental extraction with no new info yields 'no valid increment'
preconditions: Previous L1 with specific content. Current L2 identical to previous L2.
steps: Execute C-stage for turn N with text 'The sky is blue'.
Execute C-stage for turn N+1 with the same text.
Retrieve L1 JSON for turn N+1 from SQLite.
Check that core_change equals exactly '无有效增量'.
Check that all other fields (new_materials, objective_facts, consensus, todo) are either '无' or empty arrays.
expected: core_change is '无有效增量'; other fields indicate no new content.
cleanup: Delete session records for this test from DB.

title: Complete OODA text parsed to valid JSON with five fields
preconditions:
Mock LLM to return a well-formed OODA text: '核心摘要：测试摘要
资源与观察：
- 资源1
事实与约束：
- 事实1
决策与结论：
- 决策1
后续行动：
- 行动1'
steps: Feed the above OODA text to OODAParser.parse().
Verify the result is a dict with keys: core_change, new_materials, objective_facts, consensus, todo.
Verify each other key contains the corresponding list items.
expected: All five keys present; non-empty sections contain lists of strings.

title: Semantic dedup removes item with cosine similarity > 0.88
preconditions: Two vectorizable facts with cosine similarity 0.90 (precomputed). Threshold 0.88.
steps: Insert fact A into previous L1.
Create current L1 with fact B (similarity 0.90).
Verify fact B is removed from current L1.

title: Semantic dedup retains item at threshold 0.88
preconditions: Two facts with cosine similarity exactly 0.88.
steps: Verify both facts remain in current L1.

title: Semantic dedup retains item with low similarity (0.50)
Dedup threshold config change affects behavior
Robust JSON parsing success rate >= 95% on 100 malformed inputs
preconditions: Prepare a JSON file with at least 100 malformed OODA JSON strings (missing braces, trailing commas, wrong keys, truncations).
steps: For each input, call robust_json_parse and record success (returns dict) or failure.

title: LLM connection refused leads to fallback summary
steps: Verify that an error log contains 'LLM call failed' or similar.
Query database for the turn: l0_text must be '无有效增量'.
Verify no exception propagates to the caller.
cleanup: Restart Ollama LLM, delete test session records.

title: LLM timeout triggers fallback after retries
preconditions: Mock Ollama endpoint to delay response by 5 seconds. Set CA_LLM_TIMEOUT=2, CA_LLM_MAX_RETRIES=1.
steps: Verify that the call times out after 2 seconds and retries once.
After retries, verify DB contains fallback summary.
cleanup: Restore original timeout/retry config, remove mock.

title: Duplicate turn submission prevented
preconditions: Engine running, no pending task for current turn.
steps: Assign turn_index = engine._allocate_turn_index() for turn N.
Call process_turn_async for turn N twice in quick succession.
Compare returned turn_index values; they must be equal.
Check internal _pending_tasks dictionary: length must be 1 for this turn.
expected: Only one task created, same turn_index returned.

title: Turn index recovery on restart
preconditions: Database has max turn_index=5 for this session.
steps: Instantiate a fresh ContextAssembler with the same session_id.
Check that the internal turn counter is 6 (max_turn_index + 1).
Process a turn; verify the DB record has turn_index=6.

title: on_session_end waits for pending async tasks
preconditions: Start a C-stage task that takes ~3 seconds.
steps: Verify that wait time >= task duration (or timeout).
After return, confirm DB contains the turn record.
expected: Task completes before or during on_session_end; DB record present.

title: A-stage p95 latency under 200ms for 50-turn history
preconditions: Populate DB with 50 turns. Embedding backend warm (fallback acceptable).
steps: Execute assemble() 100 times in a loop.
Record latency for each call (exclude first warm-up call).

title: Layered assembly Head/Middle/Tail
preconditions: History of 5 turns. HEAD_AUTO_L1_COUNT=3, PROTECT_TAIL_TOKENS configured such that last turn is tail.
steps: Inspect returned messages: turns 0,1,2 replaced by L1 summaries, turn 3 by L0, turn 4 preserved as original.
Verify that each replaced message starts with '[~/turn_index]'.

title: Dual retrieval returns BM25 and vector hits
preconditions: Cache contains turns with keywords and semantic similarity to query.
steps: Check the result list items have a 'source' field equal to 'bm25' or 'vector'.
Assert that both 'bm25' and 'vector' appear in the result sources.
expected: Both BM25 and vector hits present.

title: RRF fusion stable and deduplicated
preconditions: Some turns appear in both BM25 and vector results.
steps: Perform retrieval 10 times with identical query.
For each call, record the list of turn_index values in order.
Verify all 10 lists are exactly equal.
Verify no duplicate turn_index in any list.

title: Budget gate respects token limit
steps: Identify which turns were upgraded from L0 to L1.
Sum the token counts of the upgraded L1 texts.

title: Replaced messages contain [~/N] marker
steps: For every message that is not an original user/assistant (i.e., a summary), extract the prefix.
Verify prefix matches pattern '[~/\d+]' and the number equals the turn_index.

title: Empty cache returns original messages
steps: Prepare a list of original messages (e.g., 3 messages).
Verify returned list is identical (by content and order) to input.
Check log for 'cache empty, returning original'.

title: Hard truncation when tokens exceed 95% window
preconditions: Cache empty. Prepare messages with token estimate > 95% of context window (e.g., 95%+1).
steps: Verify that a log entry 'hard truncation applied' or similar appears.
Check that returned message list has fewer tokens, and total tokens <= window limit.

title: No truncation when tokens exactly at 95%
preconditions: Cache empty. Messages token count equals exactly 95% of window.
steps: Assert that the returned messages are identical to input (no truncation).

title: Tool call and tool result messages preserved untouched
preconditions: Message list includes an assistant message with 'tool_calls' field and a subsequent role='tool' message.
steps: Build message list with those tool messages.
Verify the assistant message still has the same tool_calls structure and content.
Verify the tool message content and role unchanged.

title: Persistence of L0/L1/embeddings across restarts
preconditions: Write a complete turn with non-empty l0_text, l1_text, l0_embedding, l1_embedding.
steps: Close the store and create a new SQLiteStore instance pointing to the same DB file.
Read the same session and turn_index.
Verify l0_text, l1_text match exactly; embedding blobs deserialize to the original float lists.

title: Concurrent writes to different turns no corruption
preconditions: 10 threads, each assigned a unique turn_index for the same session.
steps: Spawn 10 threads, each calling write_turn with its own turn.
Read all records for the session; verify count is 10.
Check that each turn's data matches what was written.

title: Concurrent writes to same turn_index handled safely
preconditions: 5 threads trying to write the same (session_id, turn_index).
steps: Start 5 threads concurrently writing the same turn.
Query DB: count records with that turn_index; must be exactly 1.
Verify that at least 4 threads experienced an integrity error or returned False (based on write_turn return).
Ensure no deadlock (all threads finish within timeout).
expected: Exactly one record inserted, no deadlock.

title: WAL file size stays under 10MB
steps: Perform 1000 write_turn calls with varying data.
Invoke manual checkpoint if daemon not immediate.

title: Write retry on database busy
preconditions: Mock sqlite3.execute to raise sqlite3.OperationalError('database is locked') twice, then succeed.
steps: Verify that exactly 3 attempts were made (1 initial + 2 retries).

title: max_turn_index returns -1 for empty, correct max otherwise
steps: Call max_turn_index for empty session: expect -1.

title: Disk full write failure logs error but continues
preconditions: Mock store's write_turn to raise an OSError('No space left on device').
steps: Call process_turn_async which triggers a write.
Verify that ERROR log contains 'write_turn failed' or similar.
Assert that the process does not terminate and the C-stage fallback summary is attempted (or logged).

title: Multiple embedding backends return non-empty vectors
steps: Verify result is a list of floats with length > 0.

title: LRU cache hit rate >80% for repeated text
steps: Call embed('constant string') 100 times in a loop.

title: Parallel encoding ratio <= 0.6
preconditions: Measure serial baseline first using embed_batch.
steps: If ratio <= 0.5: pass; if 0.5 < ratio <= 0.6: warn (mark as 'optimization needed'); if > 0.6: fail.

title: Fallback embedding when Ollama unavailable
steps: Check that returned vector length matches expected dimension (1024).

title: Fallback vector dimension matches real embedding
steps: Call embed with Ollama running; record vector length L.
Call embed again; verify fallback vector length equals L.

title: Environment variable overrides default config
Config validation raises ValueError for illegal value
Config.reload picks up new env var
CA_DEBUG switch toggles debug logs
steps: Perform a simple A-stage operation; capture logs at DEBUG level.
Assert no DEBUG logs are emitted.
Repeat the operation; assert DEBUG logs are present.

title: Health check_all returns store and embedding status
Prometheus metrics endpoint returns text format
expected: Prometheus format text with expected metrics.

title: CompressStats log contains phase timings and upgrade count
preconditions: Run an A-stage where at least one L0->L1 upgrade occurs.
steps: After assemble(), retrieve the CompressStats instance.
Check that phase_timing dict has keys for 'retrieval', 'budget', etc.

title: Failure count increment persists to state file
Breaker opens after 3 consecutive failures
steps: Verify state file retry_after is set to a future timestamp.
cleanup: Delete state file, reset cooldown env.

title: Breaker auto-resets after cooldown
preconditions: Breaker open, retry_after set to now - 1 second. CA_CIRCUIT_COOLDOWN=10 used for testing.
steps: Sleep until retry_after has passed (e.g., sleep(11)).

title: Successful init resets failure count to zero
should_compress always returns False
steps: Call should_compress() under various states (session active, idle).

title: Normal multi-turn dialogue end-to-end
steps: Start session, send user message 1, receive assistant reply 1.
Send user message 2 that explicitly references information from message 1.
Verify database contains turn_index 0 and 1 with non-empty l1_text.
Verify that the messages sent for reply 2 contain at least one summary with '[~/0]' or '[~/1]'.
Optional: check that the assistant reply 2 contains relevant information from turn 1 (content-based assertion).
expected: DB records present, markers correct, reply 2 contextually relevant.

title: LLM unavailable degradation and recovery
steps: Send user message; basic reply should still be returned (Hermes handles).
Check C-stage log for 'LLM call failed', and verify DB has fallback summary for that turn.
Send another message; verify that the next C-stage produces a normal summary (no fallback).
expected: Fallback written, no crash, recovery successful.
cleanup: Delete test records, ensure Ollama running.

title: Circuit breaker triggers and recovers
preconditions: Set CA_CIRCUIT_COOLDOWN=10. Simulate persistent init failure (e.g., invalid DB path).
steps: Attempt to start plugin three times; each must increment failures in state file.
Fourth attempt: is_available() returns False immediately.
Fix the failure cause (e.g., correct DB path), call engine creation successfully.
Verify state file failures reset to 0.
expected: Breaker behavior correct, state file reflects reset.
cleanup: Delete state file, restore valid config.

title: A-stage and C-stage run concurrently without interference
preconditions: System running, a slow C-stage is triggered.
steps: Start a C-stage task that takes 5 seconds (mock LLM delay).
Immediately call assemble() on the same session.
Verify that assemble returns within 200ms using available cache (not waiting for C-stage).
expected: A-stage completes quickly, no concurrency issues.

title: Multiple sessions concurrent operations isolation
steps: Launch 5 threads writing turns to session A, 5 threads writing to session B concurrently.
Verify that all writes succeed, and max_turn_index for each session is correct (4 each if 5 turns).

title: C-stage background task completes within reasonable time
steps: Trigger C-stage and record start time.
Wait for task to complete (via wait_for_pending).

title: Public function docstring coverage 100%
steps: Run pydocstyle on the ca/ module and plugins directory.
Parse output; assert zero missing docstring errors.
Randomly sample 10% of public functions and manually inspect that docstrings describe parameters, returns, and exceptions.
expected: No pydocstyle errors, sampled docstrings complete.

title: Factual consistency: BERTScore and ROUGE-L of L1 summaries (Chinese)
preconditions: 50 pre-prepared dialogue samples and manually annotated reference summaries (tests/data/reference_summaries/v1.0/). CA configured.
steps: Load 50 dialogue samples and corresponding reference summaries.
For each dialogue, run CA to produce L1 summary (core_change + facts).
Compute BERTScore F1 (model: hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext) between generated summary and reference.
expected: Average BERTScore F1 >= 0.70, average ROUGE-L F1 >= 0.40.

title: Compression ratio with information retention (Chinese)
preconditions: Same dataset as TC-QUAL-001. jieba installed for Chinese word segmentation.
steps: For each sample, count Chinese characters of original dialogue and L1 summary using jieba tokenization.
Calculate average overall and per stratum.
Cross-check: corresponding BERTScore F1 from TC-QUAL-001 >= 0.70 for each sample.
expected: Overall compression ratio <= 0.3, per-stratum <= 0.4, BERTScore F1 >= 0.70.

req: Business: semantic fidelity via embedding cosine
title: Semantic fidelity: cosine similarity between dialogue and summary embeddings
steps: For each original dialogue, concatenate all user+assistant turns in chronological order, compute embedding via Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B.
Compute embedding of the generated L1 summary.
Calculate cosine similarity between the two vectors.

title: 系统消息豁免去重
preconditions: 定义辅助函数 msg(role, content, **kwargs) -> dict
steps: 断言 result[0]['role'] == 'system' 且 result[1]['role'] == 'system' 且 result[2]['role'] == 'user'
expected: result 长度为 3，两条 system 均保留，顺序不变

title: 非系统消息去重 (user/assistant)
expected: 返回 [user('A'), assistant('B')]，第二个 user('A') 被移除

title: tool 消息去重
steps: 构造 messages = [msg('tool','data', tool_call_id='1'), msg('tool','data', tool_call_id='1')]

title: 去重保持原始时序
steps: 构造 messages = [msg('user','A'), msg('assistant','B'), msg('user','A'), msg('tool','C', tool_call_id='2')]
expected: 返回 [user('A'), assistant('B'), tool('C')]，顺序不变

title: 开关启用 (CA_DEDUP_ENABLED=1)
expected: 最终仅保留一条 user 消息

title: 开关关闭 (CA_DEDUP_ENABLED=0)
expected: 两条 user 消息均保留

title: 非法值默认禁用并记录 WARNING
steps: 使用 caplog 捕获日志，断言存在一条 WARNING 级别日志且内容包含 'Invalid CA_DEDUP_ENABLED'
expected: 重复保留 + WARNING 日志

title: 性能基准：200条消息去重耗时
preconditions: 定义辅助函数，预先构造消息列表
steps: 构造 200 条消息：前 100 条为 content 递增的唯一消息，后 100 条为与前 100 条完全相同的重复消息
使用 time.perf_counter 执行 _deduplicate_messages 5 次，每次记录耗时（转换为毫秒）
对 5 次耗时排序，取第 3 个值（索引 2）为中位数，取最大值为峰值
断言中位数 < 1.0ms 且最大值 < 2.0ms

title: 调试日志输出 dedup 信息
steps: 使用 pytest 的 caplog fixture，设置 caplog.set_level(logging.DEBUG, logger='ca.__init__')
遍历 caplog.records，查找包含 'dedup: before=' 的 DEBUG 级别日志
断言找到至少一条匹配的日志记录

title: 空列表
单条消息
全部唯一消息
steps: 构造 10 条 content 分别为 '0'~'9' 的 user 消息
遍历验证 content 顺序为 '0'~'9'

title: 全部重复消息
steps: 构造 10 条完全相同的 msg('user','A')

title: 不同角色相同 content 应保留
steps: 构造 messages = [msg('user','A'), msg('tool','A', tool_call_id='1'), msg('assistant','A')]
断言 result[0]['role'] == 'user' 且 result[1]['role'] == 'tool' 且 result[2]['role'] == 'assistant'
expected: 全部保留，角色分别为 user, tool, assistant

title: 相同角色相同 content 应去重
content 为 dict 的去重
混合角色重复：user 重复 tool 不重复
steps: 构造 messages = [msg('user','A'), msg('tool','A', tool_call_id='1'), msg('user','A')]
expected: user('A') 去重后仅保留第一条，tool('A') 保留

title: content 为 list 的去重
tool_calls 字段去重
steps: 构造两条 assistant 消息，均包含 tool_calls=[{'name':'test'}]，其余字段完全相同
expected: 返回 1 条（tool_calls 被包含在指纹中，故相同）

title: 超大消息去重 (>10KB)
steps: 构造 10 条 content 为 10KB 随机字符串的 user 消息，全部相同
expected: 返回 1 条，性能无明显退化

title: 集成：去重与 A-stage 组装流程
preconditions: ca_engine fixture (已 mock LLM)，定义辅助函数 msg，设置 HEAD_AUTO_L1_COUNT=0
steps: 构造 messages = [msg('system','sys'), msg('system','sys'), msg('user','A'), msg('assistant','B'), msg('user','A'), msg('tool','C', tool_call_id='1'), msg('tool','C', tool_call_id='1')]
调用 result = ca_engine.assemble('test query', messages)
expected: result 长度为 5，两条 system 均保留，user/assistant/tool 各一条，重复项被移除

title: 集成：开关关闭时重复保留
steps: 构造 messages 同 INT-001（含 6 条消息，其中 user('A') 和 tool('C') 各重复一次）
调用 result = ca_engine.assemble('test query', messages)
断言重复消息未被移除（len(result) 应 > 5）
expected: 重复消息完整保留，列表长度 > 5
